errors.text_span: участък с непроменена стойност 14.55 през 2012 и 2013
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the blue line has a value of 14.55 in both 2012 and 2013. According to the chart labels, the value for the blue line (текущи цени) is 14.55 in 2012, but rises to 14.85 in 2013. The machine appears to have misread the overlapping labels.
